Name: (CP)  and (AT) - Ali's Overgrown Slime Hutch for 1.6
Author: sneakyham
Description:
I originally made myself a recolor of the slime hutch for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7424?tab=description]PeaslyWellbott's Slim Hutch[/url], but now that the slime hutch has shrunken for 1.6, I decided to upload it along with a few different variations for customization options that can be changed in either the config.json or more easily through [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config[/url].

Options are:
Ali's Original - based on strawberrymilk95's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/494]Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings[/url]﻿
Naeldeus's Alternative - based on naeldeus's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4564]Overgrown Fairy Buildings [/url]﻿
Slim Hutch Style
Overgrown Slim Hutch Style
Vanilla Style
Overgrown Vanilla Style
Vanilla with White Trim
Overgrown Vanilla with White Trim
